title: Belle Meade Bourbon Mixology Experience
includes: Take-home recipe card for your custom creation
Hands-on guidance from an expert Bourbon Steward
Does not include a tour of the mansion.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Craft your own signature cocktail using the rich flavors of Belle Meade Bourbon in this immersive mixology experience. Led by a certified Bourbon Steward, participants explore a selection of seasonal juices, handcrafted syrups, and aromatic bitters while learning the art of mixing and shaking.

This hands-on adventure culminates in your very own custom drink, presented in unique Belle Meade drinkware, along with a take-home recipe card. Ideal for bourbon enthusiasts and novices alike, this experience blends creativity with expert guidance in a historic setting.
